intro.me: Zgrade, predmeti i priče Gusinja i Prokletija u 3D. Okrenite ih prstom, držite ih na kocki ili ih postavite u prirodnoj veličini u prostor oko sebe.
intro.en: Buildings, objects and stories of Gusinje and Prokletije in 3D. Turn them with a finger, hold them on the cube, or place them at real size in the room around you.

description.me: Kule, kuće, džamije i javne zgrade Gusinja.
description.en: Towers, houses, mosques and public buildings of Gusinje.

description.me: Predmeti svakodnevnog života: posuđe, namještaj, nošnja i alati.
description.en: Objects of everyday life: vessels, furniture, costume and tools.

description.me: Ovo je privremeni, pojednostavljeni model za isprobavanje aplikacije. Detaljan 3D model kule i njena priča dodaju se uskoro.
description.en: This is a temporary, simplified model for trying out the app. The detailed 3D model of the tower and its story are coming soon.

description.me: Primjer kako će predmet iz zbirke izgledati u aplikaciji. Ovaj model je napravljen samo za probu i biće zamijenjen skeniranim predmetom iz muzeja.
description.en: An example of how an object from the collection will look in the app. This model was made only for testing and will be replaced by a scanned object from the museum.

description.me: Niska okrugla trpeza za kojom se jelo sjedeći na podu. Model je napravljen samo za probu i biće zamijenjen skeniranim predmetom.
description.en: A low round table for eating while seated on the floor. The model was made only for testing and will be replaced by a scanned object.
